title: Inside Halberd Mills
text: The cooperative began trading in 1999, in a converted grain store in Cawden Vale that it still occupies. Everything it sells is a wool blanket of one kind or another, and the range has barely changed. The Fenmoor design award, won in 2015, hangs framed in the entrance. Members describe the scale of the place as a couple of hundred of us, give or take.
notes: Set B. Magazine profile; reports scale as reported speech rather than a figure.
